usageNotes: Use this to inspect the cloud-init configuration that Proxmox auto-generates for a VM before or after first boot — useful for verifying that user-data, network config, or metadata will be rendered as expected. The VM must exist on the specified node and have cloud-init configured (cicustom or inline ci* options set); calling this on a VM without cloud-init yields an empty or minimal response. Requires only VM.Audit on the VM path, so it is safe to call in read-only monitoring contexts.

examples.summary: Dump the generated network config for VM 110 on node pve1

tips: Run with type=user, type=network, and type=meta separately — each returns a distinct cloud-init document (user-data YAML, network-config YAML, and meta-data respectively).

The output reflects the config that will be written to the cloud-init ISO at next VM start; changes to cicustom or inline ci* options are not reflected until the VM is restarted or the cloud-init drive is regenerated.
If the VM was cloned from a template, verify the dump to confirm hostname, IP, and SSH keys were correctly inherited or overridden before first boot.
